howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Enter header and footer text
howto.text: Optional left/center/right slots for both header and footer. Use placeholders like {page}, {total}, {date} for dynamic content.

howto.name: Apply and download
howto.text: Click Apply. The text is stamped at the top and bottom of every page in the chosen font size.

faq.q: Will the header/footer overlap existing content?
faq.a: It might if your pages have content close to the edges. Use the Crop or Resize tool first to add margin space if needed.

faq.q: Can I exclude the cover page?
faq.a: Pages-to-affect parameter accepts ranges like '2-' to skip the first page or '2-N-1' to skip first + last.

faq.q: Are these editable annotations or baked-in?
faq.a: Baked into the page content. They can't be removed without re-editing — use Whiteout to cover them if needed later.
